en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city square with a large ornate fountain in the center. Water jets arc from the fountain into a circular basin. People are standing and walking around the fountain, and horse‑drawn carriages or early vehicles appear nearby. Surrounding the square are multi‑story stone buildings with elaborate facades and mansard roofs. Handwritten cursive text covers the bottom portion of the image, and faint printed text appears along the lower edge.
